request: Analyze GSE123879 for PMID 31589602 (Dynamic enhancers control skeletal muscle identity and reprogramming.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk mRNA-seq (TruSeq stranded polyA, NextSeq 500 75bp SE) of quadriceps
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks voluntary wheel running (Ex, harvested 4-6 h after last bout) vs sedentary wild-type controls (Con) on quadriceps gene expression in male C57BL/6J mice
final.sample_inclusion: n = 5 quadriceps per group (Fig 8A legend); all 15 deposited RNA-seq samples
planned_contrasts: EX vs SED in quadriceps (S2.6.p1, Fig 8A left; paper: 779 up, 783 down = 1562 DEGs)
MTG vs SED in quadriceps (S2.6.p1, Fig 8A right; paper: 2843 up, 2739 down = 5582 DEGs) - non-exercise comparison, secondary
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one quadriceps per independent mouse
final.paper_method: STAR (mm10) + DESeq2 via Illumina BaseSpace DESeq2 v1.1.0 app, direct pairwise comparisons Con vs Ex and Con vs mTg (S4.7.p1)
final.normalization: DESeq2 internal size factors on counts; FPKM used only for heatmaps/clustering (S4.7.p1)

paper_results.named_genes: Acadl up and Myh4 down with exercise (S2.7.p1, Fig 9C)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.2.p1: male C57BL/6J mice, voluntary wheel running for 4 weeks from 8 weeks of age vs individually caged without wheels; Ex harvested 4-6 h after last bout; mTg vs WT littermates. S2.6.p1 + Fig 8A: quadriceps mRNA-seq, n=5/group, Ex and mTg each compared with sedentary wild-type controls. S4.7.p1: DESeq2, FDR-adjusted p < 0.05. S2.6.p1 writes p-value < 0.05 for the 779/783 counts, but the deposited GSE123878_ExerciseQuad_DifferentialGenes list (1562 genes = 779+783) has max padj 0.04998 and max raw p 0.0062, so the counts were made with padj < 0.05 as the Methods state. S4.11.p1 / S8.p1 name SuperSeries GSE123879.

checks: S4.11.p1 deposits all RNA-seq/ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq in SuperSeries GSE123879
GSE123879 is SuperSeries of GSE123878 (RNA-Seq, 15 samples: ControlQuad/ExerciseQuad/PGC1transgenic rep1-5)
GSE123878 supplementary FpkmValues_AllSamples has 15 columns Control_1-5, Exercise_1-5, PGC1transgenic_1-5 matching the 15 GSMs
GSE123878 data_processing restates STAR + DESeq2 FDR<0.05 as in S4.7.p1
deposited ExerciseQuad / mTgQuad DifferentialGenes lists reproduce the paper counts 779/783 and 2843/2739

ownership.reasoning: The RNA-seq samples of SuperSeries GSE123879 are exactly the 15 samples of SubSeries GSE123878; the metadata of that SubSeries (subset of the SuperSeries metadata) and its series-level FPKM matrix are used. ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq samples in the SuperSeries are not expression data and are out of scope. GSE123878_RAW.tar holds per-sample bedGraph coverage tracks only (no gene counts), so the only gene-level matrix is FPKM.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are Control_N / Exercise_N / PGC1transgenic_N; metadata titles are ControlQuad_RNAseq_repN / ExerciseQuad_RNAseq_repN / PGC1transgenic_RNAseq_repN. key is derived from title as <group>_<rep> and matched exactly. grp recoded from the title prefix, which agrees with characteristics genotype (wild type / PGC1a Tg(+)) and treatment (sedentary / exercise).

final.source: GSE123878_FpkmValues_AllSamples.xlsx (series supplementary; converted to csv; 21 Excel date-mangled gene IDs dropped by prep_fpkm.py)
final.paper_input: read counts from STAR into DESeq2 (S4.7.p1); counts not deposited

matrix.reasoning: File name says Fpkm; integer fraction 0.0, range 0-26392, non-integer values: linear FPKM. The paper's DESeq2 input (gene counts) is not deposited; RAW.tar contains only bedGraph tag tracks.

candidates.reason_rejected: not a paper comparison; the paper compares each model with sedentary controls only (S4.7.p1)
one control shared by two arms: one model with planned contrasts; difference from the paper's separate pairwise DESeq2 fits recorded as a deviation

design.reasoning: Three groups of 5 sharing one sedentary WT control set. EX vs SED is the exercise estimand (primary); MTG vs SED is the paper's second planned comparison (genetic, not exercise) kept as secondary. All male (S4.2.p1).

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, one quadriceps each, randomly assigned to wheel/no wheel (S4.2.p1). No batch, lane or sex variation recorded in GEO metadata (all submitted Dec 14 2018, single platform). No covariates added.

final.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on log2(FPKM+1)

paper_route.method: DESeq2 on STAR gene counts (BaseSpace DESeq2 v1.1.0)
paper_route.reason: gene-level read counts not deposited in GEO; only FPKM matrix and bedGraph tracks; FPKM must not be rounded into counts

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) instead of DESeq2 on counts
one joint 3-group model instead of separate pairwise fits
deposited FPKM matrix already restricted to 12,529 genes by the authors

method.reasoning: Matrix-method policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) then limma. Paper route DESeq2 blocked by missing counts; run limma as a declared deviation.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule BH padj < 0.05 (S4.7.p1; confirmed by the deposited DE list) applied to limma results. Audit rule adds |FC| > 1.5 (Fig 8A red points: absolute FC > 1.5 and adjusted p < 0.05).

threshold.reasoning: S4.7.p1 FDR-adjusted p < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff; S2.6.p1 wording p-value < 0.05 is contradicted by the deposited list (max padj 0.04998). Fig 8A FC > 1.5 used only as a labelled audit rule.

caveats: limma on log2(FPKM+1) replaces the paper's DESeq2 on counts; DEG counts are not expected to match exactly
MTG vs SED is a genetic (Pgc1a transgene) comparison, not an exercise effect
deposited FPKM matrix covers only 12,529 genes (pre-filtered by the authors); 21 Sept/March genes lost to Excel date conversion

study.reasoning: Paper counts from S2.6.p1 (779+783; 2843+2739). Acadl up and Myh4 down with exercise (S2.7.p1, Fig 9C); Myh2 (type IIa fibers increased by exercise, S2.6.p2) is up in the deposited Ex list; Ppargc1a is the transgene.

discrepancies.paper: S2.6.p1: significantly induced ... (p-value < 0.05); S4.7.p1: FDR-adjusted p < 0.05
discrepancies.data: deposited ExerciseQuad DE list: 1562 genes, max padj 0.04998, max raw p 0.0062
only FPKM (12,529 genes) and bedGraph tracks deposited
21 symbols converted to dates by Excel (2018-03-02 twice)

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One limma model on log2(FPKM+1) with the three groups; planned contrasts EX vs SED (primary, exercise) and MTG vs SED (secondary).

enrichment.reasoning: Paper runs GO/KEGG/Reactome enrichment (Metascape) on exercise DEGs (S4.7.p1, Fig 8E).
